learn.title: Learn
learn.description: A textbook and learning path: from percentages and logarithms to stochastic calculus.
learn.body: This will hold a path through 13 tracks, a map of how lessons depend on each other and a classic table of contents. Every lesson has two depths: plain language and textbook.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Exercises at five levels, from the basics to quant interview questions.
practice.body: This will hold numeric, symbolic, estimation and open exercises, graded automatically, with hints and full solutions.

interview.title: Interview
interview.description: A quant interview simulator: brainteasers, sprints and a market-making game.
interview.body: This will hold timed sessions: brainteasers, a probability sprint, mental maths, market making and open modelling questions.

debunk.title: Debunk Lab
debunk.description: Popular trading promises tested with maths and simulation.
debunk.body: This will hold claims from courses and ads, checked with numbers, plus calculators: a strategy’s expected value, luck versus skill, the economics of courses.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Terms from probability, statistics and finance, in Polish and English.
glossary.body: This will hold definitions with links to the lessons that explain them.

lab.title: Lab
lab.description: Interactive simulations and an in-browser Python notebook.
lab.body: This will hold simulations (random walks, the Kelly criterion, backtest overfitting) and a Python notebook that runs without installing anything.

about.title: About
about.description: Who makes this and why it’s free.
about.body: This will describe the project: free learning about the maths of markets, without selling courses or signals.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What data we collect and why.
privacy.body: The privacy policy will be published before user accounts launch. For now the app collects no personal data.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: The terms of use will be published before user accounts launch.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We currently use one essential cookie that remembers your language. A full policy will come with analytics.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: All content is for learning. It is not investment advice or a recommendation to buy or sell financial instruments.
